svg.text: Weekly package downloads for each protocol: official and third-party packages
27 Jul to 18 Oct 2026, across npm, PyPI and crates.io. Each panel has its own scale, from 0 to its peak.
Per registry and group, the most downloaded package is counted. The text under each panel gives the latest week by registry. CI and mirrors are included.

svg.text: Baselayer KYA: closed commercial product: no public repository or package.
Stripe SPT: proprietary API: no public repository; delivered through Stripe's general SDKs.
Amex Intent Intelligence: proprietary framework, part of the ACE Developer Kit: no specification or public repository found.
AP2: The ap2 package on PyPI belongs to an unrelated project; no other package found on npm, PyPI or crates.io.
ANS: No package found on npm, PyPI or crates.io (Go reference implementation, Swift SDK).
Official packages counted (per registry, the most downloaded)
MPP: mppx (npm, wevm, with Tempo), pympp (pypi, Tempo)
Third-party packages counted (hand-picked examples; the publisher is named)
Web Bot Auth: vestauth (npm, the dotenv author), regent-httpsig (pypi)
ERC-8004: erc8004 (crates, a community developer (qntx)), agent0-sdk (npm, Agent0 Lab)
Verifiable Intent: verifiable-intent (npm, a community developer)
Other packages of the same registry and group, not added (a package and its dependencies would be counted twice)
Web Bot Auth (official, npm): http-message-sig, jsonwebkey-thumbprint
Maven, NuGet, Go modules, RubyGems, container pulls, and copies installed without a registry. Third-party repositories are a sample, not a census
(GitHub repositories tagged with each protocol topic: MCP 37,653, x402 3,827, A2A 604, L402 110, UCP 66, Web Bot Auth 41, ACP 27, AP2 19, ERC-8004 368, AGNTCY 8).
Each registry gives a different history, so every panel covers the same 12 weeks.
